title.narrative: Solidarity Lanes - Resilience and Livelihoods Framework: Moldovan Railways Crisis Response

description.narrative:
This is a blended operation that combines an EU grant of EUR 2,000,000 and an EBRD loan of EUR 12,000,000. The objective of the Project is to provide the necessary material for the rehabilitation of strategically important railway sections on the North-Central rail section in Moldova:

¿ Valcinets to Balti : total length is 199.9km of which 32.7 km is to be rehabilitated;

¿      Balti to Ungheni : total length is 70km of which 29.6km is to be rehabilitated.

Without benefiting from major investments since its independence, the railway transport infrastructure of the Republic of Moldova is in poor condition, unfolding in speed and weight restrictions that affect more than 40 per cent of the entire national railway network. Against this background, the Russian Federation¿s war on Ukraine has put severe strains on logistic chains and trade routes in the wider region, highlighting the need for urgent investments in the transport infrastructure of countries neighbouring Ukraine, including Moldova.
